SELECT a. STATUS, a.PROD_ID, a.PROD_NAME, a.START_DATE, a.CASH_TYPE_2, a.FEE_RATE, a.CREATE_USER, a.CREATE_TIME, a.UPDATE_USER, a.UPDATE_TIME, a.DATA_SOURCE, a.DATAUUID as DATAUUID FROM PRD_FEE_RATE_DATA a
not EXISTS ( SELECT 1 from DIS_PRD_FEE_RATE_ERRORDATA b where b.PROD_ID=a.PROD_ID and b.CASH_TYPE_2=a.CASH_TYPE_2 and b.START_DATE=a.START_DATE and b.STATUS in('A','E') )
and a.PROD_ID in(#{prodId})
and a.CASH_TYPE_2 in(#{cashType2})
and a.STATUS in(#{status})
union all SELECT c.PROD_ID, c.PROD_NAME, c.START_DATE, c.CASH_TYPE_2, c.FEE_RATE, c.CREATE_USER, c.CREATE_TIME, c.UPDATE_USER, c.UPDATE_TIME, c.DATAUUID FROM dis_prd_fee_rate_errordata c
c.STATUS in('A','E')
and c.PROD_ID in(#{prodId})
and c.CASH_TYPE_2 in(#{cashType2})
and c.STATUS in(#{status})
SELECT ITEM_CODE itemCode, ITEM_VALUE itemValue FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST WHERE DICT_CODE=#{code}
